task: MR03 补测之三：启动守卫的严格原子性（A7 剩余项收尾）
closes: gap-register A7 remainder (strict atomicity of the launch guard)

result.productionChange: RunningInstanceRegistry: Entry gains a Launching flag; new TryBeginLaunch (ConcurrentDictionary.TryAdd) and AbortLaunch; IsRunning now treats a reservation as occupied. LocalApiService: HandleLaunchAsync became a reservation shell with try/finally, and the former body was renamed LaunchBodyAsync.
result.designNote: The finally can call AbortLaunch UNCONDITIONALLY because AbortLaunch only removes entries still marked Launching; after a successful start MarkRunning has upgraded the entry to Launching=false, making the call a no-op. That removes the need for an upgraded flag and shrinks the error surface.

tests.mutualExclusion: first TryBeginLaunch true; reservation counts as occupied; second rejected with existingPid=0; after release it can be reserved again
tests.abortAfterUpgrade: MarkRunningPid then AbortLaunch leaves the entry and its PID intact (this is what justifies the unconditional finally)
tests.failureReleasesReservation: a launch that fails after reserving leaves IsRunning false, so a second launch is NOT treated as already-running/starting (reservation leaks would block the instance forever - worse than under-blocking)

redBaseline: NOT REPRODUCED: replacing TryAdd with ContainsKey-then-assign (non-atomic) still yielded exactly 1 winner under 32-way concurrency, because the check-then-assign window is nanoseconds and Task.Run startup is staggered. So the concurrency test is NOT proven to catch a non-atomic implementation - stated plainly as not achieved.
selfFoundIssues: Two patch attempts failed because I did source surgery in PowerShell: v1 used index math and deleted the AppConfig config / GameInstance instance declarations (35 compile errors); v2/v3 failed to verbatim-match multi-line Chinese literals. Switching to the edit tool (read the exact text, then literal replace) worked on the first try. RULE: edit source with the edit tool; use PowerShell only to run commands.

I REPEATED a round-42 mistake: the RED restore source was the PRE-round backup, so restoring removed TryBeginLaunch while LocalApiService still called it (build would break). Re-applied the registry patch and saved POST-fix references (green/*.fixed). RULE: for a RED on a fix, always keep and restore a POST-fix reference.
Because I checked the build exit code, the over-deleting v1 patch did not produce invalid test evidence.
stillNotCovered: the RED for atomicity did not reproduce (see redBaseline)
cross-process concurrent launch: two launcher processes starting the same instance are still uncoordinated (inherent limit of an in-process registry)
runtime state is still in-process memory only
the delete-guard vs reservation interaction is correct by IsRunning but has no dedicated test
